caption: The drawing shows a single, transparent drinking glass with a slight greenish-blue tint, centered on a plain beige background. The glass has a thick base, slightly tapers outward as it goes upwards, and features curved sides. There are several small air bubbles dispersed within the glass, visible both near the sides and in the bottom. The outline and inner details of the glass are carefully rendered with subtle shading and highlights to indicate its transparency, thickness, and reflective quality. There are no other objects or decorations present, and the composition is minimal with the glass occupying the central portion of the image.
title: Tumbler
